TSGR.description: Tapered Section Group (TSGR). ZVAR and YVAR select the section-shape variation law along the z- and y-axes; when a variation is POLY the matching polynomial fields (ZEXP/ZFROM/ZDIST or YEXP/YFROM/YDIST) drive that axis, otherwise (LINEAR) they are ignored.

ELEMLIST.description: List of element numbers belonging to this tapered section group.

ZVAR.description: Section-shape variation along the z-axis. LINEAR: linear variation. POLY: polynomial variation (then ZEXP/ZFROM/ZDIST apply). Case-insensitive.

ZEXP.description: [ZVAR=POLY] z-axis polynomial exponent value. Ignored when ZVAR is LINEAR.

ZFROM.description: [ZVAR=POLY] z-axis symmetric-plane reference end: i (i-end) or j (j-end). Ignored when ZVAR is LINEAR. Case-insensitive.

ZDIST.description: [ZVAR=POLY] z-axis distance of the symmetric plane from the reference end (ZFROM). Ignored when ZVAR is LINEAR.

YVAR.description: Section-shape variation along the y-axis. LINEAR: linear variation. POLY: polynomial variation (then YEXP/YFROM/YDIST apply). Case-insensitive.

YEXP.description: [YVAR=POLY] y-axis polynomial exponent value. Ignored when YVAR is LINEAR.

YFROM.description: [YVAR=POLY] y-axis symmetric-plane reference end: i (i-end) or j (j-end). Ignored when YVAR is LINEAR. Case-insensitive.

YDIST.description: [YVAR=POLY] y-axis distance of the symmetric plane from the reference end (YFROM). Ignored when YVAR is LINEAR.
